The default driver is SQLite. The concrete INSERT executes in `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` at lines 16–48, where `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo` prepares the statement at line 41 and runs it via `QueryRowContext` at line 42. The other two candidates are `store/db/mysql/memo.go` and `store/db/postgres/memo.go`. The determination was made by tracing the default driver flag in `cmd/memos/main.go`.

The factory switch in `store/db/db.go` routes to SQLite only when the driver is explicitly set to `"sqlite"`. Without a `--driver` flag, Viper defaults to `"sqlite"`, which causes `sqlite.NewDB` to be selected over the MySQL and Postgres implementations.

**(*DB).CreateMemo** — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go`; **determined by tracing the default driver through the factory switch** (`cmd/memos/main.go:122` sets driver default to `"sqlite"` → `store/db/db.go:18-20` calls `sqlite.NewDB` → runtime `store.Driver` dispatch from `store/memo.go:113` reaches the sqlite implementation, not the parallel `CreateMemo` methods in `store/db/mysql/memo.go:16` or `store/db/postgres/memo.go:16`).

On a default install (no `--driver` / `--dsn` flags), viper defaults the driver to `"sqlite"` in `cmd/memos/main.go:122,130`. `profile.Profile.Validate()` then builds a SQLite DSN when driver is `"sqlite"` and DSN is empty (`internal/profile/profile.go:110-116`). Startup uses `db.NewDBDriver`, which switches on `profile.Driver` and instantiates only the sqlite driver when it is `"sqlite"` (`store/db/db.go:18-20`).

When a memo is saved, `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` calls `s.Store.CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:115`), which delegates to the driver interface (`store/memo.go:109-113`). With the default config, that resolves to `(*sqlite.DB).CreateMemo`, which builds and runs:
